propositions: Offline mapping-config checks must run always (stdlib-only, no Jira import) via load_mapping_config inside try/except MappingConfigError, surfacing load-time failures (non-integer hierarchy, malformed blocks) and resolve-time failures (out-of-vocabulary, unmapped-non-skipped values) as error findings with detail carrying the MappingConfigError message verbatim.

Live-drift detection against Jira status/type/link must degrade cleanly to a single unavailable finding when jira-datacenter extra is absent, credentials unset, settings resolution fails, or probe times out, never raising and preserving success exit.

Per-key offline resolution must enumerate config.projects union default layer and run provider-neutral resolvers (effective_status_map, effective_type_map, effective_link_map, assert_type_decisions_complete) independently of live-drift logic.
All-empty projects.<KEY> stub blocks must emit warning findings (not errors, not non-zero exit).

Live-drift check must reuse mapping_probe.build_probe reader and diff configured vs observed vocabulary on status/type/link axes only; hierarchy is excluded by design (Data Center probe hierarchyLevel is always empty).

Probe transport calls must run under doctor-side bounded wall-clock timeout (default 10s) with timed-out threads abandoned; timeout, settings ConfigError, empty resolved PAT, and absent extra each fold into one unavailable finding with matching reason.
